artifacts.change_initiative: The conveyor programme's ADM capability adoption (T9)

entries.axis_b: One model, one store, one action registry

value.implications: A new capability is a table plus actions in this workspace, not a new service; no feature keeps a private file or cache as its record of truth.
value.rationale: The estate's pain is distributed fragments of one model; one registry makes permission, audit and replay uniform, and its exact set is asserted by its own test.
value.statement: A programme, its projects, their work, their decisions and their evidence are rows in one Postgres database written through one action registry; a concept has one table and one set of actions.

entries.axis_b: Every mutation is an action; the database is not the API

value.implications: A new write is an action with a schema, a scope and a test; a read-only probe is BEGIN READ ONLY.
value.rationale: RFC 9457 errors, If-Match/_version preconditions, revision history and audit hang off the action envelope; a SQL write bypasses every one of them.
value.statement: A write goes through an action with its scope, tenant, precondition and event; no handler, UI or script writes rows by SQL.

entries.axis_b: Tenant isolation is structural, not a filter

value.implications: A new table ships with its policy in the same migration and a foreign-tenant 404 test; a session-level GUC through a pooler is forbidden.
value.rationale: The store's begin_scoped is the only path that sets the tenant GUC; a filtered query is one forgotten predicate away from a leak.
value.statement: Every tenant-owned table has RLS enabled and forced, and every query runs under the tenant's scope; a cross-tenant id resolves to 404.

entries.axis_b: Publication is a decision, never a side effect

value.implications: A new public surface filters on the public bit and carries the tenant; preview uses the same renderer as the public page.
value.rationale: The executor never approves its own work; documents.publish is the only action that moves the public bit, and the renderer neutralises raw HTML.
value.statement: A row is public only when an admin's publish decision makes it public; an author's write never publishes and author markup is never executable on the public page.

entries.axis_b: Every output is versioned, attributable and reversible

value.implications: A new aggregate that holds work products reuses the document model or carries the same provenance; deletion is a tombstone.
value.rationale: The programme is judged on its intermediate work products; an output a reviewer cannot trace to author, version and evidence is not auditable.
value.statement: A text output carries its author, a content hash and a revision history; every edit is versioned and a restore copies a version forward.

entries.axis_b: Programme truth is computed, never hand-written

value.implications: A new programme fact gets a generator and a --check gate; a document may explain the truth but may not be its only home.
value.rationale: A hand-written status is the first thing to rot; the standard generates every project's expected set and the pack is built from the tree.
value.statement: A project's status, units, dependencies and expected outputs come from measured sources and are regenerated by scripts; a checklist is derived from the standard.

entries.axis_b: Gates refuse; a gate that never refuses is broken

value.implications: A gate names what is missing and offers the next step; a refusal is covered at the boundary the caller uses.
value.rationale: The programme's publish and dependency gates exist because a publish without evidence happened; a refusal is the product, not an error path.
value.statement: A quality gate is a refusal with an actionable reason, exercised by a test that proves the refusal; a gate that never refused in a full cycle is treated as broken.

value.implications: A project's inception names its dependencies and the contract it sits under; a deviation is a decision record.
value.rationale: Untyped coupling hides the order the programme actually needs; the gate answers 409 blocked_by naming the open dependency.
value.statement: A dependency between projects is typed and the programme gate enforces the blocking kind; a tranche review is a programme decision on evidence.

value.implications: A credential is referenced, never printed; a public output and the snapshot are scanned before publication.
value.rationale: The repository is public, so a leak is permanent; the secret aggregate stores only a sealed form.
value.statement: A secret is write-only; no action returns its value, and no secret, token or private host enters the public repository or a published output.

entries.axis_b: The estate is one deployable service per concept, absorbed not duplicated

value.implications: A new integration adds an action and a client in this workspace; a retired service's data is migrated, not forked.
value.rationale: ADR 0005 fixes the absorption sequence; the public repository cannot carry a hidden dependency on a private host.
value.statement: A service the organisation depends on is either this workspace's own code or an absorbed, contract-tested module behind an action; a second deployment of the same concept is retired.

artifacts.purpose: The principles every delivery project designs under, adopted by the Architecture Board.
artifacts.scope: The conveyor programme and every project in it; the estate services it absorbs.
artifacts.title: Conveyor architecture principles — PF-1

value.note: A benefit recorded twice is a benefit nobody can trust; the principle makes the row the one record.
An auditable decision needs a publication act a reviewer can point at.
An auditable decision needs author, version and revision history.
An auditable decision needs gates that refuse and say why.
A public repository and a public design pack can carry no secret, token or private host.
Predictable delivery comes from typed dependencies and explicit gates.
Less bespoke tooling means absorbed modules behind actions, not a second deployment.

board.charter: The board governs the conveyor programme's architecture. It adopts the principles catalogue and the tailored ADM profile, approves architecture contracts, and accepts or rejects waivers. It cannot approve a gate it requested and cannot waive a deviation it owns. It meets at each tranche review and on a contract request. Quorum: the chair. Every decision is recorded with the evidence it was taken on.
board.commissioning_authority: The programme owner (the sponsor and decision-maker; P0's governance row)

members.note: positions, not persons; the programme architect position is held by the maintainer sessions under the owner's authority

board.name: Conveyor Architecture Board

acceptance_criteria: D1 — the artefact standard and repository: a catalog's entries are rows, an approved artefact is immutable and a supersede writes version 2, and a reuse link is searchable across plateaus.

D2 — the Preliminary capability: the tailored profile names each phase's mandatory set by plateau, the board is a governance body row, and a maturity assessment carries all nine dimensions and a skills assessment all seven categories.

D3 — the architecture project and phase gates: an approved artefact set and a live contract advance a phase, a draft artefact refuses the advance naming the artefact, and a contract change re-opens the gate.

D4 — delivery compliance: a design gate without a live contract refuses, a superseded contract refuses naming its status, and one compliance level per review and a dated waiver without an owner are refused.
D5 — change management: a review's exactly-one outcome is a change row or a kata candidate, and a review with no verdict cannot close the phase.
D6 — the console surface: the Architecture destination renders its tabs from the live aggregates and each interaction records state.
body.assignment: Deliver the TOGAF ADM capability as rows and actions in the one workspace: the artefact standard and repository, the Preliminary capability, the architecture project and its phase gates, delivery compliance, change management, and its console surface.
body.responsibilities: The programme architect (the maintainer sessions under the owner's authority) delivers and evidences each deliverable; the Architecture Board reviews and approves; the programme owner accepts the capability.
body.scope: The eleven tables of migration 0054 and the 26 architecture.* actions that expose them; the four ADM contract kinds; the seeded ten-type artefact standard; the Architecture Board; the maturity and skills baselines; and the Architecture capability screen (D6). The design is docs/plans/T9-architecture-capability.md.

dimensions.architecture_communication: The public design pack, the published output set and the required review of each document make the architecture readable; no stakeholder engagement cycle has run.
dimensions.architecture_development: The typed artefact repository exists and three Preliminary artefacts are rows with entries and links. No HLD or SD design exists for a delivery, so the discipline is exercised but not yet standard practice.
dimensions.architecture_governance: The board, the four contract kinds and the waiver rule are rows and actions; the first contract is requested and no delivery design gate has yet resolved against a live contract.
dimensions.architecture_process: The ADM phases, the four contract kinds and the phase-advance refusal exist as rows and actions (migrations/0054_architecture.sql; crates/actions/src/architecture.rs). One Preliminary capability is being accepted; no Phase A-H has yet run for a delivery.
dimensions.business_linkage: P0's benefits map names output -> capability -> outcome -> benefit -> objective; no benefit baseline has been measured, so no improvement can yet be demonstrated.
dimensions.investment_strategy: ADR 0005 fixes the absorption sequence and the business case carries the cost/risk posture; there is no formal investment appraisal or portfolio benefits tracking.
dimensions.it_security: Tenant isolation is structural (RLS on every tenant table), secrets are write-only, the repository is scanned on every PR and the public page neutralises author markup; there is no security architecture review cycle.
dimensions.operating_unit_participation: There is one operating unit (the programme itself); the organisation catalogue positions exist but no job release is bound to a running project.
dimensions.senior_management: The owner is the sponsor and decision-maker and chairs the Architecture Board, whose charter, commissioning authority and decision limits are now rows; one board decision records the capability adoption. There is no standing board cadence yet.
